title: Care-Plan Checkpoint Completion
dataSources: Symptom logs (`condition:symptom`), medication doses (`medication:dose`), vitals readings (`vitals:reading`), flare-up events (`flareup:event`), lab results (`labresult:value`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management — symptom and medication trackers (Bearable, MyTherapy), connected blood-pressure cuffs and glucometers, and lab-result portals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=medication:dose OR sourcetype=vitals:reading OR sourcetype=labresult:value)
| bin _time span=1w
| stats dc(sourcetype) as checkpoint_types by _time
| eval completion_pct=round(100*checkpoint_types/3,1)
| sort - _time
description: Checks whether each week included all the core care-plan checkpoint types you rely on: meds, vitals, and labs when applicable.
value: A compact checkpoint score shows whether the overall management routine is intact, not just one part of it.
implementation: Treat medication, vital, and lab signals as weekly checkpoints and score how many were present each week.
visualization: Line chart of weekly care-plan checkpoint completion percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It compares whether the main parts of your care routine are all happening, not just one piece of it.
